title: Overdrive routes response
description: The service's answer to GET /v1/routes (spec §11.4, ADR 0036): the routes the agent has created, newest first, without their points (GET /v1/routes/{id} gives one route with its points, route.schema.json). generatedAt is when the service answered (UTC). Rules a schema cannot state, checked by every implementation: ids are unique, createdAt is a real UTC instant and the routes are ordered newest first, then by id.
